summary: Manual extraction for rakudai-kishi-main vol-20. The volume opens at the ruined Rebellion headquarters in the Alps, where Abraham Carter and PSYON seize Bakuya Tsukikage, Kozo Kazamatsuri, Rinna and Sara after revealing the frozen corpse of the Tyrant, Adam Goetia. The postwar secret is clarified: Whitebeard, Ryoma Kurogane and their allies killed the Tyrant during World War II, then both the League and Union preserved Rebellion as a managed necessary evil; the United States now denies its own complicity to claim world justice and justify war. Carl Arlanz tortures Tsukikage and Kazamatsuri at a Tatra base, using Rinna and Sara as hostages, while explaining both the American war plan and his personal desire for unlimited experimentation. Charlotte, hidden by Sara's Roadside Ash, summons Ouma Kurogane. Ouma raids the base, confronts Abraham Carter—the true source of his old Tyrant trauma—and, after seeing Rinna and Sara's torture, abandons his pure duel ethic, absorbs the surrounding wind, perfects Danzuki Tenryuusou: Shinuchi and kills one Abraham with Ippatsu no Kaze. Arlanz then reveals PSYON as mass-produced Abraham clones based on the Tyrant's DNA; Nango arrives, saves Ouma and remains as rearguard while the captives escape toward Japan. In Japan, Kurono spends a night with her husband Takumi and daughter Mei, learning to see family as support rather than a shackle. The US Pacific Fleet's second attack uses PSYON and EDY to break Tokyo's defenses and threaten the underground civilian shelter. Kurono awakens Three Thousand Worlds, repeatedly rewrites the same time interval to defeat PSYON across the front, and buys ten minutes at the cost of near-fatal injuries. The underground defense is saved by Kaito Ayatsuji, Kuraudo, Moroboshi, Toka and returning western Japan forces. Nene, Ikki, Shizuku and Stella return from Vermillion: Nene's meteor cripples Enterprise, Shizuku and miniature Ikki freeze and break fleet ships with Ryoma-style ice swordsmanship, and Stella destroys Enterprise with Calusaritio Salamander when Douglas Upton refuses to retreat. Japan wins the defensive war. Meanwhile, Nango, Edelweiss and Fu Xiaoli raid the Tatra base to inspect the Tyrant's body, but Arlanz has already stolen Blutsauger, the Tyrant's Device, leaving a Magic Creature decoy and collapsing the hangar on them. During the victory night, Kagami reports across Tokyo, Shizuku and Alice reunite, and child-sized Ikki is accidentally dragged into a women's bath by Ayase before Toka covers for him. Stella and Ikki then share a private promise about marriage, children and staying together for life. Immediately afterward, Arlanz and an Abraham clone ambush them; Stella is electrocuted unconscious and abducted to become the mother of Arlanz's planned ultimate life-form, while Ikki is left near death in the clone's self-destruction. The volume ends by launching the final rescue battle.
